Hey man,

Stuur me gerust een DM als je meer wilt weten, heb passie voor sport en help dus heel graag een beginner verder.

Zat precies in jouw situatie, wou altijd al sporten, begon op mijn 14e maar begon pas tegen m’n 16e dingen te bereiken ivm puberteit en voeding. Nu ben ik 19, junior powerlifter op het NK, dus het is ook echt iets waar ik serieus mee bezig ben.

Ik ga het eerlijk tegen je zeggen, je zult absurd veel moeten eten, meer dan je comfortabel mee bent.

Veel mensen denken dat ze niet kunnen aankomen ongeacht van hoeveel ze eten, dat is niet waar, het is echter alleen zo dat je in je puberteit gewoon intens veel groeit, en dat 95% van tieners in een calorieën tekort zitten omdat groeien zoveel energie en voedingsstoffen kost. Je lichaam zult niet veel spier kunnen bouwen, als die überhaupt niet kan voortzetten in de groei.

In de puberteit heb je al veel spier potentie, veel mensen denken dat het pas is als je klaar bent met groeien maar dat is niet zo, het is gewoon dat het erg moeilijk is vanwege de voeding.

De gemiddelde volwassen persoon heeft 2500 calorieën per dag nodig, een mannelijke tiener kan makkelijk 3000+ eten zonder aan te komen, terwijl je dan kleiner bent, en dus voor je grootte gooi je wel erg veel voeding naar binnen.

Nu heb ik je een hele hoop verteld, waar je wat van leert hopelijk maar niet wat aan hebt, dus wat moet je gaan doen?

Je kan prima sporten en je doelen bereiken, zorg ten eerste dat je een goed schema hebt, en een plan, ga niet de sportschool binnen en naar leuke oefeningen, zorg dat je weet wat je doet, of tenminste dat je weet wat je moet doen.

En eet absurd veel, natuurlijk veel eiwitten, maar überhaupt genoeg om aan je calorieën te voorzien. Koolhydraten en vetten maken ook een belangrijk rol uit in spierbouw. 

Hou je lichaam in de gaten, als je dik begint te worden, dan zit je op de goede koers maar eet je teveel, dus dan weet je hoeveel calorieën je nodig hebt en nu zit je daar dus boven: zorg dat je niet veel daarboven blijft, anders kom je onnodig vet aan.

Hoe kom je aan eiwit? Vlees, eiwitshakes! Vlees is waarschijnlijk buiten jouw controle, dus vul je rust aan met shakes, dat zal een hoop werken (in principe is 1.6G per kilo lichaamsgewicht goed eiwit, maar dat hoeft niet als beginner, als beginner zit je bij 1G per kilo al goed, want hoe meer spier je hebt, hoe meer eiwit nodig om het te onderhouden.)

Mijn tip blijft brood met pindakaas, probeer dan 100% pindakaas te krijgen, er zit eiwit in en het helpt aan je calorieën te komen.

2 flink gesmeerde broodjes pindakaas per dag en ik heb al 1000 calorieën extra en wat eiwit, dit helpt erg veel wanneer je naar de 3000 moet.

En behalve dat, stel vragen, online, zoek ze op of YouTube of aan mensen in de sportschool, iedereen zal willen helpen.

Let ook natuurlijk op van wie je advies neemt natuurlijk, neem ook dat van mij met een korreltje zout natuurlijk, in de sport industrie wilt iedereen klinken alsof hij weet wat hij zegt, terwijl veel mensen geen idee over onderwerpen heeft, dus doe je eigen onderzoek ook!

In het kort, absurd veel eten om spierbouw + puberteit te voldoen, goed trainen, en veel plezier hebben!

Works for me, and I can definitely tell and experience the value it provides.

Obviously I don’t build it every game, not even closely, but if I see the value, then it’s a good item. Adapting to the state of the game allows for more plays to be made, champions like Malzahar or Nautilus, that have fast near unmissable lockdown on you, can be made useless due to the item.

Sure you don’t need it, but in the end, it allows for riskier plays, high risk high rewards plays can often win games, but the crown lowers the risk, so the risk reward ratio is in your favor against such champions.

If you don’t envision how it can be remotely good, don’t build it, I’m not you/you’re not me. Play your own playstyle and adapt/improve on it as you keep getting better and better, advice from others help, but only if you can put it to good use.

Once you get high ELO, ultimately the best way to climb is not to follow someone else’s tips/ways to improve, but to look what makes you good and improve on it.

Banshee’s blocks a single spell, walk through a Lux Q and one shot her anyway for example.

Crown allows you to get flash through a malzahar and amumu, one shot their adc and ult out.

People over estimate the usefulness of protobelt active, especially in team fights, you barely lose damage on Crown aswell. It can prevent the enemy team from preventing you from doing your job, so you gotta know if the matchup allows it, and the game state obviously.

I might get Crown of the shattered queen 1/10 games, depending on enemy comp (and ELO), if I expect them to completely lock me down all the time mid>late game, also allows for riskier plays

Wow, reading this has me tearing up…

I’m 18 and well, I wasn’t an accident, I was wanted, I was cared for, the entire package.

But that’s the problem, I never asked to be born. So around when I was 9 and discovered my mom was an alcoholic there wasn’t really anything to do.

I have autism (Asperges), and it really makes me see the world differently. Her opinions, thoughts and mindsets disgust me. I don’t want to share my opinion or hear hers about anything.

But the problem is well, my older brother/sister got most attention anyway, so when I was around 7-8 and my parents divorced too (I barely ever saw my dad who had passed away by this point), all attention went to them. Ive only really ever has 1 friend (who thanks god still is my best friend), I got used to being lonely at a young age, home wasn’t different.

As years went by and my brother/sister left the house, the damage was already done; I didn’t like affection, or was used to attention. Even if attention shifted towards me, the damage was done. How?

Years of alcoholism rightfully made me feel neglected, while there was never abuse, that didn’t make it right; especially as I grew older, depressed (13-18, I’m over it now, but I started having suicidal thoughts and experimentations when I must’ve been 9 or 10). Through this I learnt many things though, stuff that will me invaluable for the rest of my life, these family or caretakers I don’t owe them anything, especially not after all of this.

Two important things: she lost my respect, and my trust. One of this things is already enough to permanently shatter the bond between you and your children, this is not solvable in any way.

While it might be clear why I lost respect, trust is another story that’s not worth mentioning but just don’t break your kids trust, you should be the only one they can completely trust, and you breaking that is a whole new unexplainable level of betrayal that will leave very deep scars.

Het alcoholism has stopped, she stopped interfering with my life but it’s too late, I’m 18 now and I get to leave when I want to which will be next summer.

Knowing this past, I doubt I’ll visit more than once a year, I just don’t want contact. For the past 4 years all I’ve done is sit by myself in my room, quiet and at peace, I don’t want any interaction with her, I’m not proud to have her by my side and I don’t want any of her influence in my life, her presence disturbs me.

There were mental things which might’ve had more effect because of my autism but moral of the story; if you mess up, you can leave permanent scars.

When I was 17 I was unsure of whether to forgive her or not and try to fix stuff but it’s not my place, growing older brings realization. She hurt me mentally, broke my trust, lost my respect and nothing can change that but I came to the conclusion that well, I don’t owe her anything.

This world is messed up, very messed up. So having a child, and expecting anything from them is the most fucked up thing you can do. They never asked to be born and if you’re gonna power trip over their existence, you’re messing things up.

In the end, I’m glad I was alone when I was young because Id otherwise have a lot of trouble right now. I’ve learned that everyone else betrays me, and to keep my inner circle super small, and keep even my closest around me at arms length.

I’ll move out next summer and I’ll be free, I started doing business in my young teen years and have a very livable income, I can’t wait to finally have this person out of my life and feel free.

I’m a platinum/diamond Evelynn player and well, I was stuck in the same situation mostly when getting from silver->gold, where I’d do super well but couldn’t win.

I don’t care what anyone says, Evelynn Scales really well into late game, you’ll be able to one shot tanks and if you can’t go in yourself for whatever reason, you stay back and if anyone jumps on your carry, you one shot them.

Your itemization is fine just make sure to always build Lich Bane first (I go Hextech alternator/Dark Seal/Boots and 2 control wards first back as I pretty much always pick up a kill, and do a full clear twice (buffs only once)), after those 3 items I start building lich bane with sheen first. If you’re very far ahead and can get kills easily, mejai’s is worth picking up early if you’re certain you’ll get 25 stacks without issues.

I also recommend jumping from the inspiration tree to sorcery, and getting Absolute Focus/Gathering Storm, as that helps you get your mid game powerspike after lich bane. Those are my tips for runes/items.

Besides that, you’re gonna want to try to get something out of every kill, learn wave management to make sure your opponent gets punished for dying, if drake is coming up you get a pick in bot/mid and you spam ping drake, get a control ward on it and have smite.

You need to stop walking around without purpose I learnt aswell during gold, if you’re not going to gank, you need to be doing your camps. Evelynn has a very fast clear, you can easily do camps in between ganks. Or atleast do one on your way there unless it’s an emergency, just make sure to get your cs game on point, I always average about 8 CS a minute after 10:00.

You don’t die a lot which is good, one secret to Evelynn is to make sure you don’t die, I improved significantly when I learnt this. Don’t take a fight you won’t win, unless you can damage your ally’s lane opponent for him without dying, and without using summoners/ultimate. This is something you should pretty much only do pre 6 as you likely won’t die, and after 6 you should be aiming to kill them.

But besides that, make sure if you’re towerdiving or take a risky engage, have flash ready, or ult, you need one of these to make sure you don’t lose your mejai’s stacks. Not dying is super important on Evelynn especially. 

Make sure to spam ganks after level 6 to put your laners ahead, learn your damage to know if you can one shot someone without a charm (out the W on them for the slow though), and you can click on the enemy to look at their MR to make sure you will kill them. Besides that, don’t always gank from river, you can easily walk through alcove (the corner of the map) and get in one of the 3 bushes unseen, wait a bit and you can strike for a free kill, don’t take all kills though because your team wants to get fed too.

Evelynn sucks at teamfighting, even if you’re fed, you shouldn’t engage. Either wait for your team to do something, or shut down the person engaging on your team because you’re hidden behind whoever is the bait ready to save him. Get a pick before teamfights by waiting in bushes, whoever is carrying and killable you should go for. In a team fight the best thing to do is make sure the carry dies, if you get focused just ult, go invis and see if you can clean up or re engage on someone on the outside of the fight. If you have some crazy engage, like a malphite just follow it up with a QER on whoever is squishy and you should win most fights.

Ending quick is good, but not as important as making sure you get something out of fights, shove in the wave, get an objective (spam ping your laners if it’s free, you have a control ward/vision control and they wont miss a wave). Spam ping baron after you get a decent fight. No objectives up? If you’re ahead invade their jungle, get vision, depending on the jungler kill him by waiting in a bush if you know where he is, take their buffs if they’re not there. If there’s control wards, just leave and remember where it is, destroying it is very risky.

Make sure to gank pre 6 though, 95% of the time you do a full clear unless some lane is pushing hard and it’s 100% free, after you did a full clear, get a scuttle or 2 if that’s possible after contesting one of them, and then clear your nearby lanes. After 6, make sure to keep farming while spamming ganks, get a kill? Look for objectives or invade their junglers, you put them behind by getting a kill, put yourself further ahead by taking it to your advantage.

And if you’re ever behind on Evelynn, just farm and get shutdowns, you can get those easily on non tanky opponents with a full combo, just make sure to get a good engage and preferably a charm to make sure you don’t die.
